text:
Dana Li: Heads up — Polaris Labs disputed renewal invoice 141220. They say an HSM pass-through looks charged twice and a platform promo appears twice. Can we triage?
Marco Alvarez: Ugh. Drop the invoice lines and I'll pull the ledger.
Dana Li: Snippet from invoice 141220:
```
Invoice 141220 (renewal)
- Private deployment license: $90,000
- Platform fee (annual): $13,500
- Platform promo credit: -$3,000
- Platform promo credit (duplicate): -$3,000
- HSM vendor pass-through: $5,500
- HSM vendor pass-through (duplicate): $5,500
- Support (Premium): $20,000
Total: $128,500
```
BillingBot: (automated) Received dispute for invoice 141220. Scanning invoice history and vendor memos. Detected duplicate HSM pass-through and duplicate platform promo credits created during a billing migration window. Opening case BLG-2026-1425. Recommended single consolidated credit note.
Marco Alvarez: Metering + vendor invoice V-2048 show one HSM charge of $5,500. Duplicate entry came from an account adjustment that was reimported.
Owen (CS): Polaris says they'd like clarity on whether the promo is still valid after their mid-term support upgrade. They remember a conversation about promos surviving upgrades.
Legal - Priya: Check contract: promotional credits expire on tier change unless amendment states otherwise. However, if the credit was applied previously on an invoice we often treat it as already-consumed value; still we can correct duplicates. Suggest neutral language.
Dana Li: Proposal: issue a single credit note for net amount instead of separate memos. Math: remove duplicate HSM (+5,500 credit to customer) but they have an extra platform promo (-3,000) duplicated which actually increased their credit. Net effect = 2,500 credit in the customer's favor.
Revenue Ops - Jen: We typically issue CN applied to next invoice unless customer asks for refund. Approving CN-8021 for $2,500 to be queued. Finance to handle refunds if requested.
Marco Alvarez: I'll attach vendor invoice and ledger export to the case. Also flag Billing Eng to add a dedupe check on vendor pass-through ingestion (ENG-BILL-213).
BillingBot: (automated) Credit note CN-8021 queued for $2,500. Case BLG-2026-1425 created.
Owen (CS): I'll message Polaris with this draft: "We found an internal billing duplication on your renewal and have issued a corrective credit note for $2,500; attached are the corrected invoice and credit note. If you prefer a cash refund instead of applying the credit to your next invoice, please let us know." Looping Legal for review.
Legal - Priya: Minor edit: replace "internal error" with "internal billing duplication" and add "no action required on your part unless you prefer a refund." Keep short and factual.
Dana Li: Final plan: apply CN-8021 as credit to next invoice, reissue corrected invoice PDF, attach CN and reconciliation, and notify customer with Legal-approved language. If Polaris asks for cash refund, route to payments with case BLG-2026-1425 and tag "refund-approval".
Marco Alvarez: Uploaded reconciliation CSV and corrected invoice PDF to the case.
BillingBot: (automated) CN-8021 applied. Corrected invoice 141220-REV1 issued. Case BLG-2026-1425 updated to resolved.
Owen (CS): Polaris replied, prefers credit to next invoice. Marking as resolved on the account side; will follow up when the next invoice posts to confirm.
Dana Li: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
